meta_data.base_class: Track the progress of projects based on specific <software development paradigms> - refers to structured processes, models, or methodologies used for building software.

tool_template.name: track_<class>_project_progress
tool_template.description: Track the progress of a <class>-based project, providing updates on completed and pending tasks.

solutionID.description: The unique identifier for the technical solution whose progress is being tracked in the <class> project.

date.description: The date for which the progress update is requested, format YYYY-MM-DD.

progressMetric.description: Specifies the metric used to measure progress for the <class> project. Options include 'Story Points', 'Tasks Completed', and 'Hours Logged'.

teamID.description: Identifier of the team whose progress is being tracked within the <class> project.

includeBurndownChart.description: Indicates whether the progress report should include a burndown chart visualization for the <class> project.

communicationMode.description: Defines how progress updates should be communicated to stakeholders for the <class> project. Options include 'Email Summary', 'Dashboard Only', 'Slack Notification', and 'Report Export'.

riskFocus.description: If true, the progress tracking output will highlight high-risk items or impediments within the <class> project.
